rules.axes: Unreal component / bone space as the FBX import gives it (Convert Scene on, Force Front X off): the vehicle faces -Y, its right is +X, up +Z; the bodies face +Y at rest.
rules.point: a point or direction in a vehicle node's glTF frame (or the vehicle root's, the clips' space), metres (x, y, z) -> the same vehicle bone's Unreal space, cm (100 x, 100 z, 100 y)
rules.root: notes root [x, z, yaw] -> character root bone in the vehicle's component space: location (100 x, 100 z, 0) cm, rotation FRotator Yaw = -yaw in degrees
rules.onePose: one-pose clips (one key in the GLB) are written as 2 identical frames (0 and 1)
rules.loops: loops (car-drive, heli-fly) keep their closing frame: 241 frames, frame 240 = frame 0; the notes give 240 per-frame values, the curves here 241

door.gltf: local rotation = rest * Rx(-55 deg * door)
door.unreal: bone-space rotation = rest * FQuat(X, +55 deg * door)  (FRotator Roll = -55 * door)

wheel_deg.gltf: local rotation = rest * Ry(wheel)  (+ = turned left)

door.gltf: local rotation = rest * Ry(+68 deg * door)
door.unreal: bone-space rotation = rest * FQuat(Z, -68 deg * door)  (FRotator Yaw = -68 * door)

cyclic_fwd_deg.gltf: local rotation = rest * Rx(-fwd) * Rz(-right)  (pivot at the floor)

collective_deg.gltf: local rotation = rest * Rx(+coll)  (+ raises the grip)

pedal_m.gltf: translation (0, 0, -push) in the parent (vehicle root) frame, push = +pedal for pedal_L, -pedal for pedal_R (+ pushes the left pedal forward)
pedal_m.unreal: component-space translation (0, -100 * push, 0) cm added to the bone (forward = -Y)

seat_driver.why: seat slid fully forward on its rails (0.20 m) and down (0.03 m)

steering_wheel.why: wheel telescoped 0.06 m towards the driver along its column

pilot_seat.why: seat 0.145 m forward: the backrest against the back as the hands hold the controls (pass A3)
